paras: The AT-R2 Swan Neck Wing lets you unleash the Formula One spirit on your Toyota GR Supra. It's made of prepreg carbon fibre with Taller uprights (95mm height) to improve performance and appearance. It delivers 250+ pounds of downforce at 110 mph, making it the pinnacle of weight reduction and speed. ADRO's Swan Neck Wing will elevate your GR Supra. *This does not include the main plate. Uprights only.*
If you're unsure whether this will fit your vehicle, contact our team of experts via email at hello@iilumolab.com and send through a few photos of the car for us to verify fitment.
